release_notes:
-  Geschichte: added the Pathway Geschichten (126 stories with Fragen) in Fraktur (Druckt) and Handschrift. Proofreading is in progress. 'Alle Geschichte' now prints only the selected book. 
-  Calendar: birthdays of non-students now repeat every year, show on the birthday form and can be deleted from any year.
-  Calendar: events of students who left school are hidden from the date they left (taken from Notes). Changing a student's Status now adds a dated line to Notes.
-  ABC Schreiben: Added options to print Flash Cards.
